how_to_read.event: n=<6 letters>;src=user;kind=...;also=...;st=...;prod=...;<payload>. No iso key. who uses party, not rel. prod empty means the current product; all or a 1-based get_account position otherwise.
how_to_read.q: Open question. yes, no and accept act only when q matches §11.1. Otherwise ignored, no state change.
how_to_read.hangup: close_outcome/close_reason a hang-up would use (§11.3). outcome null means the product-state slot is unnamed for this snapshot.
how_to_read.close_order: farewell tts, then close_call, no user turn between them.
how_to_read.w_go: call_tool sets w_go to go (one-shot tool edge).
how_to_read.cur: 0-based index of the product under discussion. prod is 1-based.
how_to_read.state: Snapshot of the key fields AFTER the step. Not a diff.
how_to_read.state_unchanged: Business state equals the previous snapshot. Every st=partial step has this. A robot answer, a t=terms discount question, and a third-party 'what is this about' also leave it unchanged.
how_to_read.tool_event: success and failure are absolute counters after the return. delta_* is the change from pending.snap_*. ok is the string true or false, or null when the mapping did not run (HTTP 500).
how_to_read.say_exact: contains are substrings the spoken text must include. text, when present, is exact. wording says whether that exact line is quoted from the contract or the brief.
how_to_read.close: One action. The farewell is inside it. close_call is not a separate step. farewell_exact true means match farewell. Otherwise match every farewell_contains substring; farewell is a canonical line that satisfies them.
how_to_read.tokens: Scripted, not the reducer's random token. Before a user step the harness sets st.tok to event n. Before the first user step last_tok is kstart. Tool steps are hub runs with pending set; they ignore ev.
how_to_read.customer_id: public-test-set.json has no customer_id. These fixtures use c_pub01 .. c_pub13.
how_to_read.readme: tests/fixtures/reducer/README.md records the ambiguities and the choice made in each case.
